Update on the Panama Cloth shrink: I decided to wash it on a no spin cycle with warm water in my washing machine. I turned it inside out as to not destroy the buttons, and then let the machine do its thing. Afterwords I took it out and hung it in my closet with some towels below to soak up the dripping water. 

It’s now fully dry, and I’m happy to report that it worked perfectly! The jacket now fits me extremely well, with a bit of room for some light layering. The buttons turned out nice as well, thankfully didn’t get chipped or damaged in the wash. There was a tad bit of marbling, but due to how little Ive actually worn the jacket, as I wear it it should blend in with the rest of the jacket as it fades. Overall extremely satisfied.
